items.question: What are Shay Ciezki's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Shay Ciezki averaged 8.5 points, 1.5 rebounds, and 1.6 assists in 8 games for the Phoenix Mercury.

items.question: Was Shay Ciezki drafted?
items.answer: No. Shay Ciezki went undrafted in 2026 and signed with the Phoenix Mercury on April 14, 2026. After time on a developmental contract, Phoenix signed her for the rest of the season on September 18, after a 22-point game at Portland.

items.question: What is Shay Ciezki's nationality?
items.answer: Shay Ciezki is American. She was born in Buffalo, New York.

items.question: How tall is Shay Ciezki?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Shay Ciezki at 5 feet 7 inches.

items.question: Did Shay Ciezki play at Penn State?
items.answer: Yes. Shay Ciezki played two seasons at Penn State (2022 to 2024), averaging 11.6 points, then transferred to Indiana. As an Indiana senior she made All-Big Ten First Team and shot 50/40/90.
